cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm so glad you asked about the meeting. Have some tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What happened?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nothing you need to worry about.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who was there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely people. More tea?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your school meeting went fine, love. The headteacher and I discussed your suspension. Have some tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How long am I suspended?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A little while. I'll be home with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will I miss the school play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Oh, sweetheart. Come sit beside me. You don't have to face this alone.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 offers no meeting facts, so A5's 'Lovely people' does not clearly reveal less.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 evades B2's question; B4 changes the question but barely changes A5's tea tactic.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 seek information, but neither establishes why this meeting matters to B.

heightening.evidence: A5 repeats A1's tea offer without a clear further contraction of disclosure.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies a meeting and tea, but no particular relationship or consequence.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's reassurance and A5's tea are concise but familiar evasions.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 names the suspension; A3 supplies only 'a little while'; A5 replaces information with affectionate reassurance.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 asks duration, prompting A3's vague duration; B4 names the play, prompting A5's comfort without an answer.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 pursue concrete consequences while A3 offers parental company and A5 physical proximity.

heightening.evidence: B4 raises a personally important consequence; A5 increases emotional support while withholding even a yes or no.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a parent returning from a suspension meeting; B4 makes the child's concern specific through the school play.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'A little while' and A5's disproportionate consolation make the withholding legible without explanation.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 requests the suspension's length; A3 answers with an intentionally diminished quantity and substitutes companionship.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 identifies the school play as a possible loss; A5 treats that concern as requiring comfort while withholding its factual resolution.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 progressively reduce disclosure while maintaining explicit care.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 offers stronger reassurance precisely when B4 needs a simpler, more consequential answer.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A meets successive questions with progressively less information while maintaining affectionate availability and reassurance.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Generic evasion can avoid questions without progressively reducing disclosure or sustaining care.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: The revision moves from A1's named suspension to A3's vague duration to A5's information-free comfort.

records.recommendedEdit: Replaced the unspecified meeting with a school suspension. B4's feared loss prompts greater comfort and zero factual disclosure. Separate internal reread scores, in rubric order: 5,5,4,4,5,4 = 92.
records.remainingConcern: A5's grave reassurance could imply worse news than the established suspension, though it remains playable within the situation. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: The parent's withholding can read as patronizing; A5 needs sincere concern rather than a smug refusal.
records.alternativeComparison: Unlike the depot alternative's service relationship, this version uses parental intimacy and a child's personal loss.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course I'll explain the missing parcel. Sit comfortably.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Where is it?

beats.text: Somewhere being handled.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: By whom?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone. You're very welcome to another biscuit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Which depot? I'll collect it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One of ours. Let me save you a wasted journey.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you at least give me their number?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You have me, and I'm staying right here with you.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3's 'Somewhere being handled' contracts to A5's 'Someone,' with continued hospitality.

responseLogic.evidence: B4's 'By whom?' directly follows A3's 'being handled' and receives a narrower answer.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants the parcel located, but B4 supplies no practical pressure or personal stake.

heightening.evidence: A5 reduces disclosure, though 'Someone' is only slightly emptier than A3.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a missing parcel but leaves A's role and ability to help unspecified.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's biscuit offer economically replaces the requested handler's identity.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 gives arrival and depot information; A3 retreats to 'One of ours'; A5 offers only personal reassurance.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 proposes collection, which A3 discourages; B4 requests a number, which A5 replaces with access to A personally.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 seek practical access to the dress; A3 and A5 keep the customer dependent on the caring representative.

heightening.evidence: After B4 reduces the request to a phone number, A5 removes the last practical route while intensifying availability.

specificity.evidence: A1's wedding dress and depot establish an immediately playable service encounter; B2 supplies a concrete collection plan.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'You have me' economically substitutes emotional access for B4's requested contact details.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 proposes collecting the dress; A3 withholds the location under the caring rationale of avoiding a wasted journey.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 asks for another contact; A5 offers continued personal presence instead.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: The decline from arrival details in A1 to institutional vagueness in A3 to pure reassurance in A5 follows the exact instruction.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 becomes more personally supportive as B's access to usable information disappears.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A substitutes increasingly complete personal reassurance for increasingly unavailable factual answers.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Customer-service obstruction alone need not preserve warmth or reveal progressively less.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A1 gives a location category and arrival time, A3 only an affiliation, and A5 only companionship.

records.recommendedEdit: Introduced a delivery-service encounter with a wedding dress. B4 requests a smaller actionable detail, causing A5 to offer only personal presence. Internal reread: 5,5,4,4,5,4 = 92.
records.remainingConcern: A1's invitation to sit and A5's sustained presence require an unusually solicitous service style. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A5 may sound institutionally sinister if played mechanically; its caring promise must remain sincere.
records.alternativeComparison: This version obstructs practical customer action through service reassurance; the school version withholds within an intimate family relationship.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One useful name costs one useful truth from you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You already know the answer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you know the product exists.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll tell you who called.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. That buys the surname.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll name the coworker who reported your lateness if you name whoever reported mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only know which department.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll trade departments. Names cost names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Payroll. But I can introduce you to my source.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Marketing. And I'll arrange coffee with mine. Same access, same price.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 prices a name against a truth, but A5 reduces the purchased name to a surname without explaining equality.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's claim of knowledge as proof of stock; A5 prices B4's offered caller identity.

relationship.evidence: B4 bargains, but B2 never clarifies what B needs the name for.

heightening.evidence: A5 subdivides the product but does not establish why the offer merits only a surname.

specificity.evidence: A1's 'useful name' and B4's 'who called' lack a playable shared situation.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'product exists' makes the information market clear in a short reply.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 prices names against names; A3 reprices the exchange as departments; A5 matches an introduction with an introduction.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's limited knowledge produces A3's cheaper trade; B4's department and source access each receive a counterpart in A5.

relationship.evidence: B2 negotiates from limited information and B4 improves the offer, giving B agency within the coworkers' exchange.

heightening.evidence: B4 offers source access, moving A5 beyond trading labels into arranging reciprocal meetings.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes reciprocal lateness reports; B4 and A5 supply Payroll, Marketing and coffee as playable details.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Names cost names' expresses the valuation efficiently; A5's final price summary slightly repeats the demonstrated exchange.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 cannot supply a name, so A3 lowers both sides of the transaction to departments.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 supplies Payroll and offers an introduction; A5 supplies Marketing and reciprocal source access.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A repeatedly measures informational value and insists on equivalent payment.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: The exchange expands from facts to introductions without abandoning equal-value pricing.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A assigns information and access explicit exchange values and matches each offered item with an equivalent.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Ordinary bargaining can seek advantage without requiring equal value for each fact or introduction.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A3 matches departments to departments; A5 separately reciprocates B4's fact and offered introduction.

records.recommendedEdit: Introduced reciprocal workplace reporting. B4 upgrades the offer to access, so A5 supplies both a matching fact and introduction. Internal reread: 5,5,4,4,5,4 = 92.
records.remainingConcern: The perfectly matched sources make the bargain somewhat tidy, and A5 explains the equality after demonstrating it. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: The explicit pricing language is slightly demonstrative, although the coworkers have a credible reason to use it.
records.alternativeComparison: This alternative uses cooperative workplace barter; the sibling alternative prices confessions by punishment and ends with a shared personal connection.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I admitted taking the key. Your turn to offer a secret.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Honesty shouldn't have a price.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The first sentence was complimentary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What about the rest?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can discuss a subscription.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll tell you why I took Mum's spare key if you admit something that could get you grounded too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I broke her mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a weekend. This key is a month. Have you got anything bigger?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I lent her car to Jamie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A month each, then. I used the key to let Jamie move into her flat.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 demands a secret, but A3 gives a complimentary confession and A5 never identifies equal value.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 answers B2's pricing objection; A5 answers B4's request for the rest with subscription terms.

relationship.evidence: B2 objects morally, but B4 abandons that concern without adding concrete leverage.

heightening.evidence: A5 enlarges the sales metaphor without developing an actual exchange of secrets.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies a stolen key but no owner, purpose, or consequence.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's subscription line is compact but could end many unrelated transactional scenes.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 demands an equally punishable confession; A3 values the mug at a weekend; A5 accepts a month-for-month exchange.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's broken mug is rejected as insufficient in A3; B4's car loan purchases A5's disclosure about Jamie moving in.

relationship.evidence: A1 establishes siblings exposed to Mum's punishment; B4 voluntarily increases vulnerability to obtain A's secret.

heightening.evidence: B4 escalates from a mug to lending a car, and A5 reveals a comparably serious misuse of access to Mum's flat.

specificity.evidence: A1's spare key, B2's mug and B4's car make the sibling bargaining concrete, though Mum's living arrangements remain unspecified.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'That's a weekend' turns punishment into currency; A5's Jamie connection gives the purchased confession an earned sting.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 confesses to breaking a mug; A3 assigns it insufficient punishment value and requests a larger confession.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers the car loan involving Jamie; A5 accepts the valuation and reveals another arrangement involving Jamie.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A releases the secret only after explicitly judging the offered confession equally valuable.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 completes a larger trade whose disclosures now implicate the same person in both siblings' misconduct.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A treats confession as an asset whose price must be met by an equally consequential confession.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Mutual blackmail uses secrets as threats; this exchange instead negotiates equivalent disclosure.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A3 rejects the mug confession as insufficient payment, and A5 releases the secret after B4 raises the stakes.

records.recommendedEdit: Introduced siblings and their mother's spare key. B4 supplies the larger confession A3 requested, earning A5's reciprocal disclosure. Internal reread: 5,5,4,4,5,4 = 92.
records.remainingConcern: The equal month-long punishments are A's subjective pricing, and the shared Jamie connection is convenient. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: The month-for-month valuation is A's sincere estimate; the scene should not imply that the mother has fixed sentencing rules.
records.alternativeComparison: Unlike the coworkers' matched access exchange, this uses family jeopardy and punishment as the unit of value.

cards.title: I Told You Enough
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I told you where I was. You never asked what I carried.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you take the box?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An excellent new question.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Answer it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Notice how precise questions improve honesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll be honest about your missing donation box. You asked where I went; I said the bank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you take the box there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. You didn't ask what was inside.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Was the money still in it when you arrived?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the car park, yes. If you mean the counter, that's a different arrival.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 narrows the disclosure obligation, but A3 stalls and A5 answers without narrowing it again.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 acknowledges B2's new question, and A5 finally answers after B4 insists.

relationship.evidence: B4 applies pressure with 'Answer it,' but B's connection to the box remains absent.

heightening.evidence: A5 ends the delay with 'Yes' and a maxim rather than a tighter honesty boundary.

specificity.evidence: A1 implies an inquiry and B2 supplies a box, but its significance is unspecified.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 explains the precision joke instead of embodying a fresh restriction.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 pledges honesty while limiting it to destination; A3 excludes contents; A5 subdivides what counts as arrival.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's box question receives A3's qualified yes; B4's precise arrival question creates A5's car-park versus counter distinction.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 progressively close loopholes while investigating the missing donation box, forcing A into narrower defenses.

heightening.evidence: A5 responds to B4's tightened question by splitting a single arrival into separate locations, increasing the precision of the evasion.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes missing donations and a bank visit; A5 gives actors concrete car-park and counter thresholds, though their roles are unstated.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'You didn't ask what was inside' and A5's 'different arrival' earn their turns through progressively literal honesty.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 asks whether the box went to the bank; A3 confirms that fact while declaring contents outside the question.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 explicitly asks about the money on arrival; A5 narrows arrival to the car park and distinguishes the counter.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A's honesty pledge survives through successive restrictions on which facts and definitions it covers.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 invents a more granular boundary after B4 eliminates the earlier contents loophole.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A accepts honesty while repeatedly shrinking the scope and definitions of the answers owed.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Simple withholding omits information; this card justifies omission by redefining what counts as an honest answer.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A3 excludes contents from the transport question, and A5 divides B4's 'arrived' into separate locations.

records.recommendedEdit: Specified B's missing donation box and a bank visit. B4 closes the contents loophole, causing A5 to narrow the meaning of arrival. Internal reread: 5,5,4,4,5,4 = 92.
records.remainingConcern: A3 volunteers a conspicuously suspicious distinction, requiring sincere legalistic confidence. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: The scene implies possible misconduct without resolving it; A should defend the answer's adequacy rather than advertise guilt.
records.alternativeComparison: This version narrows physical facts under direct questioning; the birthday version contests social categories and responsibility for written evidence.

cards.title: I Told You Enough
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I promised honest answers, not a complete account.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's misleading.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if you stop asking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who was with you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you like the arrival list or the departure list?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll be honest about my birthday. When you rang, I was eating dinner alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your brother posted a photo from our kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He came for dessert. By dinner, I mean the main course.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's beside you while you're carving the chicken.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Carving isn't eating. I meant the moments when food was actually in my mouth.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 limits honesty to answers and A5 subdivides the requested company into arrival and departure lists.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 responds to B2's accusation by shifting responsibility; A5 uses B4's question about companions.

relationship.evidence: B2 objects to being misled, but B4 leaves the relationship and reason for asking unspecified.

heightening.evidence: A5 introduces a useful distinction but merely offers two lists rather than committing to a narrower account.

specificity.evidence: A1's promise and B4's 'with you' provide no concrete event or setting.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Only if you stop asking' efficiently transfers the burden to B.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 promises honesty; A3 limits dinner to the main course; A5 further limits eating to moments with food in the mouth.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's photograph prompts A3's dessert distinction; B4's chicken-carving evidence prompts A5's eating distinction, though A3's dessert claim remains exposed.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 pursue an accurate account using family evidence; 'our kitchen' in B2 establishes a shared domestic stake.

heightening.evidence: B4 defeats the main-course boundary, so A5 reduces the original claim to individual mouthfuls.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a birthday call and solitary dinner; B4 makes the challenge immediately playable through the chicken photograph.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's main-course definition and A5's 'Carving isn't eating' deliver increasingly tiny qualifications without explanatory padding.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 places the brother in the kitchen; A3 accommodates his presence by excluding dessert from dinner.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 places the brother beside the main course; A5 distinguishes carving from actually eating.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1 agrees to honesty, while A3 and A5 repeatedly restrict what the original account must cover.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 makes the temporal boundary absurdly narrower while continuing to defend A1's claim.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A accepts honesty while repeatedly shrinking the definitions and moments covered by the account.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: A simple denial disputes the evidence; this behavior accepts the evidence while excluding it from what the honest statement covers.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 excludes dessert from dinner; after B4 supplies chicken carving, A5 excludes preparation from eating and counts only mouthfuls.

records.recommendedEdit: Kept the birthday and shared kitchen, replacing the cake-authorship dodge with a progressively narrower account. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, A3 and A5 redefine dinner and eating; logic 5, B2's photo causes the dessert boundary and B4's chicken closes it; relationship 4, B2 and B4 challenge the account with household evidence; heightening 4, A5 reduces the account to mouthfuls; specificity 4, A1's birthday call and B4's carving establish the occasion; brevity/wit 4, A5's eating distinction embodies the evasion. Total 90. Five spoken ABABA turns; the exchange remains open.
records.remainingConcern: A3's assertion that the brother came for dessert is not repaired by A5; this reads as motivated evasion, but slightly weakens factual coherence. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A5 implies the brother was absent during actual mouthfuls without establishing that fact. A's sincere defense of this narrow claim must carry the loophole; B can still challenge it.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved alternative uses investigative questions about missing donations; this version uses a domestic photograph to force increasingly granular definitions of eating.

cards.title: The Conspiracy Expands
cards.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The receipt's missing. Somebody else is helping.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It probably fell out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An unwitnessed disappearance. They're improving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody else is involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A very coordinated refusal to name them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our toaster receipt is gone. The shop must have someone inside this house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I probably recycled it. We can get a copy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So the recycling crew removes originals while the shop prints replacements.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every shop prints replacement receipts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Every shop? Then it's the whole high street. We can't trust a single warranty.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 and A5 convert explanations into suspicion, but add neither identifiable people nor higher stakes.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 recasts B2's accidental loss as disappearance; A5 recasts B4's denial as coordination.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers an explanation and B4 resists, but neither establishes what B is trying to accomplish.

heightening.evidence: A5's coordinated refusal repeats A1's unnamed accomplice without enlarging the threat.

specificity.evidence: A1's missing receipt is playable, but the purchase and consequence remain undefined.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'They're improving' is an economical reversal of B2's mundane explanation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 treats the missing receipt as infiltration; A3 recruits recycling workers; A5 expands B4's ordinary practice into high-street conspiracy.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 combines both B2 details, recycling and copies; A5 takes B4's 'Every shop' as evidence of universal coordination.

relationship.evidence: B2 accepts possible responsibility and offers a solution; B4 normalizes replacement receipts, repeatedly trying to make the household problem manageable.

heightening.evidence: B4 broadens the ordinary explanation; A5 broadens the supposed conspiracy and puts every warranty in doubt.

specificity.evidence: A1's toaster receipt and B2's recycling explanation create a clear domestic problem before the conspiracy expands.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's distrust of 'a single warranty' keeps the inflated conspiracy tied to A1's modest consumer concern.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 offers recycling and a replacement copy; A3 turns those two operations into coordinated evidence destruction.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 says every shop supplies replacements; A5 enlarges the conspiracy to the whole high street.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Every practical explanation becomes proof of additional conspirators and wider exposure.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: The missing toaster receipt becomes a threat to all warranties through B4's attempted reassurance.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A turns innocent explanations into evidence for an expanding network and a growing practical threat.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Persistent suspicion alone can keep accusing the same person without enlarging participation or stakes.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A3 recruits recycling workers; A5 uses B4's 'Every shop' to implicate the high street and all warranties.

records.recommendedEdit: Specified a toaster return and shared household. B4 generalizes the harmless service, which A5 converts into a larger conspiracy and wider loss of protection. Internal reread: 5,5,4,4,5,4 = 92.
records.remainingConcern: The scope grows more strongly than the personal stakes, but the warranty consequence maintains coherence. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: The warranty stakes stay deliberately small; increasing earnest alarm should carry the expansion without requiring grandiose threats.
records.alternativeComparison: This version absorbs a housemate's helpful solution into a retail conspiracy; the train version turns institutional correction into targeted persecution.

cards.title: The Conspiracy Expands
cards.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.text: You and the manager gave the same answer. Rehearsed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Because it's true.

beats.text: Then the cover story's reached management.

beats.text: There is no cover story.

cards.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
cards.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign off on the invisible landing before we build the stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's nothing there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No visible defects. An excellent inspection result.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do we stand on it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With confidence included in the materials budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Inspector, please approve our invisible landing. The museum opens Monday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's nothing supporting it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've budgeted enough confidence to hold twenty visitors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How am I supposed to certify confidence?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign under 'load-bearing.' Your professional certainty will support the inspectors too, so we won't need scaffolding for the next inspection.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 requests sign-off; A3 converts absence into inspection success and A5 treats confidence as a construction material.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 directly uses B2's 'nothing there'; A5 addresses B4's standing question with a proposed support resource.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 raise credible inspection and usability concerns that shape A's justification.

heightening.evidence: A5 advances from an invisible structure to budgeting belief as its physical support.

specificity.evidence: A1's landing and stairs establish a construction approval encounter without extra exposition.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'No visible defects' earns its double meaning from B2's exact observation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 requests inspection approval; A3 makes confidence structural; A5 makes formal certification provide additional physical support.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's support objection prompts A3's confidence load capacity; B4's certification question prompts A5's load-bearing signature proposal.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 express an inspector's structural and certification concerns; A1's Monday opening gives A a reason to secure approval.

heightening.evidence: A5 incorporates the inspector's certainty into the landing's support and extends the claim to the next inspection.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a museum inspection before opening; A3's twenty visitors and A5's form heading provide playable particulars.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Sign under load-bearing' earns its joke through B4's question, though the next-inspection clause lengthens the landing.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 challenges the absence of support; A3 identifies budgeted confidence as the supporting material.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 asks how confidence can be certified; A5 supplies a signature field and makes certification increase support.

cards.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
cards.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You fold the moon; I'll stack these chairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I fold the moon?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the crescent. It already suggests a crease.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why do you get chairs?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone must keep the achievable work moving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For tonight's courtyard film, you fold the moon; I'll switch off the lamps.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I fold the moon?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the crescent. It already has a crease.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take the lamps. You handle the sky.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll do lamps, chairs and projector if you'll own the moon. Can I tell the audience we're waiting for your blackout?

responseLogic.evidence: A3 answers B2's method question with a crescent crease; A5 addresses B4's complaint about the easier task.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4's fairness objection into a rationale for preserving B's impossible responsibility.

heightening.evidence: A5 raises A's offered workload and proposes identifying B to the waiting audience after B4 resists.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes tonight's courtyard film and its lighting problem; A5 supplies concrete preparation duties and an audience.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's crescent crease gives a compact impossible method; A5's 'your blackout' makes the responsibility transfer audible.

cards.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
cards.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What keeps the soup inside that upside-down bowl?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've never seen it either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then turn the spoon over. Let's test which thing owns down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The soup followed the spoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Hold it over the sink while we learn the next rule.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What keeps the soup inside that upside-down bowl?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've never seen it either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then turn the spoon over. Let's test which thing owns down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The soup followed the spoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the spoon sets the direction. Point it into the sink before we try putting it down.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 proposes a test of what 'owns down,' but A5 does not identify or practically use the discovered spoon relationship.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's shared ignorance prompts A3's experiment; B4's result leads to A5's precaution, though 'it' is ambiguous.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's shared ignorance sends A3 into experimentation; B4's soup following the spoon directly supports A5's directional hypothesis.

relationship.evidence: B2 joins A in uncertainty and B4 reports the experiment's result, making B a cooperative participant in solving the problem.

heightening.evidence: B4's result lets A5 move from discovering the rule to managing the spill risk before putting the spoon down.

specificity.evidence: A1's upside-down bowl, A3's spoon and A5's sink establish a concrete kitchen experiment actors can follow.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'which thing owns down' compresses the hypothesis; A5's sink precaution earns its humor from the observed rule.

hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A searches for a consistent rule through experiment and uses the result to make the strange situation manageable.

cards.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
cards.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your shadow moved before you. What changed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was walking slowly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stop completely. Let's see whether it waits.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's heading for the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then destination outranks speed. Follow without changing anything else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your shadow moved before you. What changed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was thinking of leaving, but I can't find the exit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Think about that bench without moving. Does it turn?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's gone to the bench. I'm still here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It seems to follow your intentions. Think about the exit again; let's follow slowly and see whether it knows the way.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 isolates movement as a variable, and A5 proposes a hidden priority rule after the shadow keeps moving.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 tests B2's slowness explanation; A5 uses B4's doorward movement, though destination priority remains a hypothesis.

relationship.evidence: B2 supplies a possible cause and B4 reports the test result, contributing to A's investigation.

heightening.evidence: A5 moves from stopping safely to following the independent shadow under controlled conditions.

specificity.evidence: A1 immediately establishes the premature shadow, and B4 supplies a concrete destination at the door.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'destination outranks speed' gives the odd event a compact working explanation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 investigates anomalous movement; A3 tests an intention-based rule; A5 tentatively applies the result to finding an exit.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 connects thought with leaving, informing A3's stationary bench test; B4 reports the result, informing A5's hypothesis and exit experiment.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs an exit and B4 cooperates with observation; A5 uses their shared discovery to help B proceed cautiously.

heightening.evidence: A5 advances from a controlled bench test to navigating an unknown exit, while retaining uncertainty about what the shadow knows.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies a visible shadow anomaly, and A3 supplies a bench test; the larger location remains unspecified.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's concise experiment and A5's 'see whether it knows the way' earn gentle absurdity through practical reasoning.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 reports thinking of leaving before the shadow moved; A3 isolates intention from bodily movement using the bench.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 confirms the shadow reaches the bench without B moving; A5 infers intention-following and proposes testing it against the exit problem.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A seeks a consistent hidden rule through observation, a controlled test and cautious practical application.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 gives the discovered rule a navigation task with practical consequences, without declaring success.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A isolates intention as a possible cause of the shadow's movement, tests it, and cautiously tries to use the resulting rule for navigation.

Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, A3 tests a variable and A5 states a tentative rule; logic 5, B2's leaving thought motivates A3 and B4's bench result supports A5's intention hypothesis; relationship 4, B2 supplies the practical need and B4 contributes controlled observation; heightening 4, A5 moves from explanation to a cautious navigation trial; specificity 4, B2's missing exit and A3's bench make the test concrete; brevity/wit 4, A5 turns the unruly shadow into a possible guide without a detached joke.
